review_state_at_supersession: ALL 12 -007 event logs EMPTY (zero human decisions); superseding destroys no human evidence
decision_rule_applied: Synthetic reference==optimized (semantics essentially preserved) BUT real regeneration != frozen -007 => optimization is NOT the culprit; the frozen artifact was generated under different state/logic. Per plan: do not force compatibility; mark superseded, freeze corrected deterministic spec, generate clean -008, run twice, compare.

root_causes.detail: historical_edges() globs g3-interface-queues-*/*.json at run time, which now includes -006 and -007 itself. Frozen build saw 677 excluded edges; regeneration sees 713. The exclusion set is order-of-creation dependent and self-referential, so the frozen selection is not reproducible.

eligible_centers computes contrast from float32 array subtraction then casts to float64; the pure-python reference uses float64 throughout. ~3e-7 differences can flip stratum membership for near-boundary candidates and perturb sha256 hash-rank selection.

Two builder scripts (build_g3_007_axis_neutral.py and build_g3_007_axis_neutral_paired.py) both claim to produce protocol-003/-007. Which one produced the frozen artifact is not determinable from the artifact alone.
root_causes.evidence: both files present in tools/ with overlapping ids

internal_determinism: The paired builder's stratum+hash pipeline is internally deterministic (run1==run2); the non-reproducibility is due to RC1 (external state) and RC2 (float), not RNG.

corrective_specification_for_008.pinned_exclusion: Historical excluded edges MUST be an explicit enumerated snapshot written into the -008 protocol (with sha256), not a live glob. -008 excludes exactly the edges enumerated at -008 creation and records them.
corrective_specification_for_008.stable_contrast: Contrast computed in float64 from float64-promoted raw, matching the pure-python reference exactly (atol=0).
corrective_specification_for_008.single_builder: Exactly one -008 builder module; the -007 builders are retained only as historical record and not used prospectively.
corrective_specification_for_008.double_run_gate: Generate -008 twice from identical inputs into two locations and require byte-identical canonical manifests before any review.
